beats.summary: Jan explains an incentive program to Michael to increase sales with a prize for the top seller.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Alan and I have created an incentive program to increase sales.
Jan: At the end of the month you can reward your top seller with a prize worth up to a thousand dollars.

beats.summary: Michael misunderstands the incentive program and questions if promoted salespeople can win the prize.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Um, question: Does top salesman include uh, people who were at one time such outstanding salesman that've been promoted to…
Jan: No, Michael. No. You can't win this prize.

beats.summary: Michael reluctantly agrees to talk to Katy, a handbag salesperson who arrives at the office.

evidence.snippet: Pam: There's a person here who wants to sell handbags.
Michael (exhales loudly, looks out window and sees Katy): Oooh, alright I'll talk to her.

beats.summary: Michael allows Katy to use the conference room for selling handbags despite usual rules against solicitors.

evidence.snippet: Michael: So uh, you know what? I usually don't allow solicitors in the office but today I am going to break some rules, and you can have the conference room. It's yours. All day.
Pam: There's an HR meeting in there at 11:30.

beats.summary: Michael compares Katy to Pam and tries to help Katy by introducing her to coworkers and offering coffee.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Ah, Katy. Wow. Look at you. You are, uh you're like the new and improved Pam. Pam 6.0.
Michael (handing Katy a mug of coffee): There ya go. Nice steaming cup o'joe.

beats.summary: Michael introduces Katy to various coworkers and discusses office dynamics including HR and office romance rules.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Here is Toby from Human Resources. Katy, Toby.
Michael: I live by one rule. No office romances. No way. Very messy. Inappropriate. No.
